calls.title: Managed Warehouse
calls.summary: The discussion covered the end-to-end pipeline of event data from SDK ingestion through Kafka into Clickhouse, highlighting key challenges such as attribute management and UI limitations. Jeremy explained the enriched events table structure and the handling of identifiers alongside user metadata. The team acknowledged existing bugs in materialized views and discussed plans to simplify data management by removing key attributes. Enhancements to allow for real-time feedback in the user interface were proposed, alongside a hybrid cloud solution for real-time event processing. Operational challenges, including user data inconsistency and limits on event volume from free accounts, were also addressed.
calls.keywords: Managed Warehouse, SDK ingestion, Clickhouse, materialized views, fact tables, attribute metadata
